kultivator.technique.phoenix_fire_line.d: A thin golden flame line breathed from the mouth (14→35 blocks): 1.2× and burning 0.25×/s for 6 s.
kultivator.technique.phoenix_fire_line.s: Source: Soul Land · 凤凰火线, Ma Hongjun's 1st soul skill: a line of flame breathed from the mouth, very hard to put out
kultivator.technique.phoenix_fire_line.l: A line of flame that will not die.
kultivator.technique.phoenix_bathing_fir: A flame mantle for 20 s: an aura (radius 3→7) of 0.3× that sets foes alight every second; Fire Resistance, Fire arts +30%, and your melee hits set foes burning for 4 s.
Source: Soul Land · 浴火凤凰, Ma Hongjun's 2nd soul skill: flames cover the body and strengthen the first skill
The phoenix bathes, and the fire grows brighter.
kultivator.technique.flame_splitting_tsu: Charge 1 s, then a crimson wave rolls forward (20→48 blocks, 6→14 wide): 2.5×, knockback and burning 0.3×/s for 5 s.
Source: Battle Through the Heavens · 焰分噬浪尺: dou qi gathered into Xiao Yan's Heavy Xuan Ruler and released at once
The heavy ruler splits the waves of flame.
kultivator.technique.phoenix_arrow.desc: 1→5 phoenix arrows seek foes within 48 blocks: 2.0× each, then a burst (radius 2) of 1.0× and burning 0.3×/s for 4 s.
kultivator.technique.phoenix_arrow.sourc: Source: Against the Gods · 凤凰箭 Phoenix Arrow, a realm of the World Ode of the Phoenix (凤凰颂世典)
kultivator.technique.phoenix_arrow.lore: Each arrow trails a phoenix feather.
kultivator.technique.ten_thousand_crow_v: 12→40 fire crows pour out over 3 s and hunt foes within 24→40 blocks: 0.8× and burning 0.3×/s for 5 s each, at most 5 per foe.
Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 64 · 萬鴉壺 of Luo Xuan: "万只火鸦飞腾入城，口内喷火"
The vase opens; the sky turns black with crows.
kultivator.technique.heaven_fire_transfo: Three stages (recast within 30 s): Fire arts +40% and Speed; then +90%, Fire Resistance and Strength; then +150%, Slow Falling and an air jump. The form lasts 30 s from the last stage; afterwards 20 s of Weakness II and no qi regeneration.
Source: Battle Through the Heavens · 天火三玄变, created by Xiao Xuan and kept by Burning Flame Valley: it bursts the Heavenly Flames, hurts the meridians, then a weak period follows
Every stage burns brighter, and the price comes after.
kultivator.technique.phoenix_sky_roaring: Foes within 5→14 blocks are stunned for 2 s; lava geysers erupt under 8→16 of them: 2.5×, launch and burning 0.4×/s for 5 s.
Source: Soul Land · 凤凰啸天击, Ma Hongjun's 4th soul skill: nearby foes are stunned and burned by lava erupting skyward
The earth roars, and the lava answers.
kultivator.technique.nine_dragon_fire_co: A fire cover (radius 6→16, walls) over the aimed spot for 4.5 s: 1.2× and fire every half second; when it closes, 4.0× to everything inside.
Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 13/46 · 九龍神火罩 of Taiyi Zhenren: it traps Shiji and burns Sun Tianjun to ash
Nine dragons coil around a cage of fire.
kultivator.technique.samadhi_true_fire.d: Channel 3 s: a cone of true fire (12→24 blocks) every quarter second, 0.8× and burning 0.5×/s for 10 s (full damage to fire-immune foes, ×1.5 to wet ones) plus Blindness; five flame carts guard the spot for 10 s, 0.6× per attack.
kultivator.technique.samadhi_true_fire.s: Source: Journey to the West ch. 40–42 · Red Boy's 三昧真火: he beats his nose and breathes it while his five carts blaze; the Dragon Kings' rain only makes it burn hotter (ch. 41)
kultivator.technique.samadhi_true_fire.l: Water only feeds the true fire.
kultivator.technique.eight_trigrams_furn: An Eight Trigrams furnace (radius 16→28) for 10 s: 1.0× every second (×2 to undead); foes are drawn in for 3 s and rooted 7 s (bosses 1.75 s); at the end 4.0× within 8 blocks of its centre.
Source: Journey to the West ch. 7 · Laozi refines Sun Wukong in the Eight Trigrams Furnace for 49 days (the Fiery Eyes are the separate Fiery Golden Eyes art)
What enters the furnace is refined or reduced to ash.
kultivator.technique.phoenix_flame_sears: Dive as a fire phoenix along your aim (48 blocks, 3.0×), then a blaze (radius 10→18) of 6.0×, burning 1.0×/s for 8 s and fire for 8 s.
Source: Against the Gods ch. 440/563 · 凤炎焚天 Phoenix Flame Sears the Heavens, a realm of the World Ode of the Phoenix
The phoenix descends, and the heavens burn.
kultivator.technique.golden_emperor_flam: A golden flame sea (radius 20→32) for 10 s: 1.5× every second, stripping Resistance, Absorption, Strength, Regeneration, Fire Resistance and Speed from monsters.
Source: Battle Through the Heavens · 金帝焚天炎, 4th on the novel's Heavenly Flame Ranking, the Gu clan's inherited flame (Xun'er)
Golden fire takes even the strength of the strong.
kultivator.technique.tongtian_divine_fir: Eight fire pillars around an octagon (radius 14→24, walls) for 6 s: each pillar strikes one foe for 1.2× every second; at the end 6.0× to everything inside.
Source: Investiture of the Gods ch. 52 · 通天神火柱: Yunzhongzi raises eight pillars by the trigrams, each looses 49 fire dragons, and Wen Zhong dies
Eight pillars, eight trigrams, one fire.
kultivator.technique.nine_suns_heavens_f: Charge 3 s, then nine suns fall on the densest packs (radius 8→12 each, 6.0× and burning 2.0×/s for 6 s); a last sun of 12.0× in radius 24.
Source: Against the Gods ch. 1007/1197 · Nine Suns Heaven's Fury, 10th realm of the Golden Crow's Record of the Burning World; Huo Poyun charged it for fifteen breaths
kultivator.technique.emperor_flame.desc: An emperor's flame lotus (radius 32→40) for 20 s: 2.0× and fire every second; inside it your Fire arts cost no qi and cool down faster; each kill adds a stack (max 22); at the end 15.0× + 0.5× per stack in radius 40.
kultivator.technique.emperor_flame.sourc: Source: Inspired by 帝炎 Emperor Flame, the legendary 1st of the 23 Heavenly Flames (Battle Through the Heavens)
kultivator.technique.emperor_flame.lore: The first of all flames bows to no one.
